plan.title: Vendor submits commercial bid after technical response

steps.note: Open the prepared Tech+RFQ event on its technical round, satisfying the required prepared-state starting point.
Continue in Vendor A's supplier portal while keeping the buyer session available.
Open the event's commercial RFQ bid sheet after the technical response has been completed.
Accept the required commercial-stage terms before submitting the quote.
Enter the requested commercial quote of 100.
Submit the vendor's commercial RFQ response.
Verify that the vendor portal marks the commercial bid as submitted.
Return to the buyer console to inspect the resulting comparison data.
Open Master QCS for the prepared event.
Verify that Master QCS shows the submitted commercial price of 100.
